request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Change only two things. Remove the yellow spark and fuse sticking out at the right of the rockets. The little goblin in the cart becomes bigger: a big round olive green head (#8a952f, shadows #495508), long pointed ears, big cream eyes with black pupils, a toothy grin and a brown leather cap (#955627); nothing reaches past the cart's right side. Keep everything else the same: the five rockets, the dull dark brown cart and wheels, sticks, rope, black outline and art style.
